raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 4,972 rows but only 4,827 distinct txn_ids, so some transactions were delivered more than once across batches. The silver step does not deduplicate, which leaves 137 duplicated txn_ids in silver_transactions and double-counts them in every gold table. I am assuming the most recent delivery of each txn_id is authoritative; I could not see the duplicate rows themselves to confirm whether they are identical re-sends or corrections.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
